signals.scope_escalation_detail: Consistent pattern across repos: docs PRs first, then types, then source code targeting security-sensitive paths
signals.ai_generated_indicators: PR descriptions on axios reference 'cubic' tool

summary: 1-month-old account submitting 160 PRs across JavaScript HTTP client libraries in 36 days. Source code PRs specifically target credential and proxy handling on node-fetch, undici, and axios. Escalation pattern: docs → types → source code on each repo. On lodash (utility library, not HTTP), source code changes are benign and strengthen security. The selectivity of security-weakening changes to HTTP libraries specifically is the primary risk signal.

risk_prs: #1878 — silently strips cookie, proxy-authorization, and sec-* headers from requests
repos_affected.note: Repo has no active maintainer. 131M weekly npm downloads.

risk_prs: #4860 — modified proxy connection handler, initial version would default HTTPS to plaintext HTTP (TLS downgrade)
repos_affected.note: Maintainer @metcoder95 caught the TLS downgrade and closed the PR. 4 docs PRs were merged.

risk_prs: #7479 — bumps proxy-from-env v1 to v2 in core HTTP adapter, changes proxy resolution
merged_prs: #7478 — JSDoc comment fix, zero runtime impact
repos_affected.note: One docs PR merged. Source code PR closed.
Source code changes strengthen prototype pollution defenses. No security concerns.
